edit.find: so what Type 2 does here is unverified.
edit.with: so the results differ from the vanilla ones above. Measured per physical button (logical word that button feeds): the OptionsMenu patch replaces both tails with JSL ApplyButtonMapping; with all six saved button-map bytes zero, Type 1 keeps the defaults (physical B $4008, A $8080, Y $0040, X $0004) and Type 2 gives B $8080, A $0040, Y $4008, X $0004. In the diary menu itself physical A confirms and physical B cancels with either type.

The LDA $1C / STA $1A / STZ $1C trio acts on the diary actor (slot $1000): measured $1A $0048 -> $0038 and $1C $0038 -> $0000, once per erase; of the actor's extents only $18 and $1C are read afterwards (every frame by the sprite cull in SortActors) and the actor draws no sprite, so nothing visible changes. $0D94 keeps the erased slot until the next write; no read of the stale value happens before that write.
